question: Who among the following Indian cricketers were named the Wisden's cricketer of the year in the 2022 edition of the Almanack?

options.text: Surya Kumar Yadav and Axar Patel

solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohit Sharma and Jasprit Bumrah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Rohit Sharma and Jasprit Bumrah were named the Wisden's cricketers of the year in the 2022 edition of the Almanack.

• This prestigious recognition is awarded by Wisden, a cricket reference book published annually in the United Kingdom.

• Rohit Sharma, known for his exceptional batting skills, has been a significant contributor to Indian cricket with numerous records to his name.

• Jasprit Bumrah, acclaimed for his unique bowling action and ability to deliver in crunch situations, has been a vital part of India's bowling attack.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Wisden Cricketers' Almanack**

• Often referred to simply as "Wisden" or "the Bible of Cricket," it is a cricket reference book published annually in the UK.

• It is considered the world's most famous sports reference book.

• The Almanack features articles, essays, and match reports, along with statistics and records.

• Wisden Cricketers of the Year are considered one of the highest honors in the sport, recognizing excellence in cricket.

• **Rohit Sharma**

• Rohit Sharma is an Indian international cricketer and the current captain of the Indian national team.

• He is a right-handed batsman and an occasional right-arm off-break bowler.

• Rohit is known for his record of scoring three double centuries in One Day Internationals (ODIs).

• He has also achieved the highest individual score in ODIs with 264 runs.

• **Jasprit Bumrah**

• Jasprit Bumrah is an Indian international cricketer who plays for the Indian national team in all formats of the game.

• He is known for his unorthodox bowling action and deadly yorkers.

• Bumrah has been a key player for India in both Test and limited-overs cricket.

• He is recognized for his ability to bowl in the death overs and his skill in swinging the ball both ways.
